Subject: Supplier intake: legal entity & PO routing info needed

Hi Samir —

Thanks for agreeing to move forward. To get Aperture set up in our procurement system and start routing POs, we need the following canonical details from your side:

- Full legal entity name as it should appear on contracts and invoices
- Tax ID / EIN and W9 (US entities)
- Remit-to address for mailed checks (if applicable) and preferred remit email for e-invoices
- Primary AP contact (name, email, phone) for PO/invoice follow up
- Bank details for ACH (bank name, routing, account last 4) — we store masked info in the vendor profile
- Any preferred PO number or invoice reference fields you require
- Certificate of insurance (if value of work > $25k)

If you can attach a completed W9 and the ACH instruction file, that will let us create the vendor record this week. If you have a preferred PO escalation or a specific PO approver, let us know so we can add it to the profile.

Quick note on POs: Redwood sends a standard PO PDF to the remit email and also includes the PO number in the EDI / accounting export. If Aperture prefers invoices routed to payables@aperturelabs.com, we'll lock that as the remit email.

Target: create vendor record and approve a one-time test PO by Friday 5/22.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Tessa
